title: Geography and geopolitics
learning_outcomes: Explain maps and resources in the context of geography and geopolitics.
Compare and distinguish state interests in the context of geography and geopolitics.
Apply geopolitical explanations in the context of geography and geopolitics.
Evaluate and justify decisions about nonviolent policy options in the context of geography and geopolitics.

lessons.title: Maps and resources
lessons.outcome: Explain maps and resources in the context of geography and geopolitics.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving maps and resources; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to geopolitical briefing.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain maps and resources from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of maps and resources; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: State interests
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish state interests in the context of geography and geopolitics.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving state interests; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to geopolitical briefing.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain state interests from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of state interests; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Geopolitical explanations
lessons.outcome: Apply geopolitical explanations in the context of geography and geopolitics.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving geopolitical explanations; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to geopolitical briefing.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain geopolitical explanations from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of geopolitical explanations; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Nonviolent policy options
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about nonviolent policy options in the context of geography and geopolitics.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving nonviolent policy options; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to geopolitical briefing.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain nonviolent policy options from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of nonviolent policy options; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of maps and resources; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of state interests; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of geopolitical explanations; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of nonviolent policy options; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Historian, economist, legal or policy specialist as appropriate.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
